When you hit a Surprised creature with a blowgun attack, use a Reactive Action to add 2 to the damage dealt.
Attacks with blowguns are +1 Enhanced.
Spend 1 ReP to reload a blowgun after attacking with it, requiring no action.
When you hit a Deposed creature with a club attack, use a Reactive Action to add 1 to the damage dealt.
For 1 AP, make a club attack against a creature you have already damaged, this turn.
Attacks with clubs are +1 Enhanced.

After attacking with a dagger, you may immediately use a Reactive Action to throw the dagger (regardless of whether the attack hit or missed), making an additional attack against the same creature or another within range.
When you hit a Surprised or Vulnerable creature with a dagger attack, use a Reactive Action to add the creature's Pain Limit to the damage dealt.
If you trigger a Pain Response in a creature with a dagger attack, deal 1 direct damage to the creature again at the start of your next turn.
After using an action to draw your flail, you may use a Reactive Action to attack with it.
For 3 AP, make a single attack with your flail. The attack targets all creatures within 1 Pace of you but damage dealt to each creature cannot exceed 1.

When you would deal 1 or more damage to a Size 5 or smaller creature with a flail attack, you may choose to Grapple the target instead of dealing damage. Checks you make to maintain this grapple are +1 Enhanced.

After attacking with a hand axe, you may immediately use a Reactive Action to throw the hand axe (regardless of whether the attack hit or missed), making an additional attack against the same creature or another within range.
When you throw a hand axe you are holding with two hands, the attack deals an extra 1 damage.
Attacks with hand axes are +1 Enhanced.
When you see a creature within your light crossbow's Intended Range shoved 1 or more Paces, you may use a Reactive Action to make an Advantage Attack against it with your light crossbow.
When you would make a light crossbow attack, you may fully reload your light crossbow, instead.
Your light crossbow attacks ignore the Threatened State.
At the cost of 1 ReP, activate a Basic Weapon Perk you have access to when using a makeshift weapon.
At the cost of 1 ReP, activate a Great Weapon Perk you have access to when using a makeshift weapon.
At the cost of 1 ReP, activate a Specialized Weapon Perk you have access to when using a makeshift weapon.

For 3 AP, make a Called Shot (6) using a mallet against a creature with a neck facing away from you. On a success, deal damage to the creature equal to its Pain Limit. A creature reduced to 1 or fewer Hit Points by this damage becomes permanently Debilitated.
When you hit a creature within 2 Paces of you with a thrown mallet, you may use a Reactive Action to catch it. Otherwise, it will land at your feet.
After catching a mallet with a Reactive Action, you may throw the mallet as part of that same Reactive Action.
While holding a short sword, you may use a Reactive Action to impose +1 Flaw on an attack against you before the attack is rolled. At 20th level, this becomes +2 Flaws.

When an attack within melee range misses you while you are holding a Short Sword, you may use a Reactive Action to deal 1 direct damage to the attacker. You may deal this damage without spending an EP if you have already used Short Sword Deflection against the triggering attack.
After dealing 1 or more damage to a Size 5 or smaller creature with a short sword attack, you may use a Reactive Action to swap places with the target.
Spend 1 EP to increase the Extended Range of all spears you throw by 10 until the end of the current turn.
All spear attacks are +1 Enhanced.
Your thrown spear attacks deal an additional 1 damage to creatures hit within the spear's Extended Range.
For 4 AP, make a single attack roll with your staff. The attack targets all creatures within 1 Pace of you, but damage cannot exceed 1 on each target.
While wielding a staff, your Pace increases by 1.
When you would deal 1 or more damage to a Size 5 or smaller creature with a staff attack, you may choose to trip the target instead of dealing damage. A creature tripped in this manner falls Deposed.
Your battleaxe attacks deal an additional 1 damage for each Enhancement on the attack, to a maximum of an additional 3 damage.
While wielding a battleaxe with two hands, the weapon deals an additional 1 damage.

When you would deal 1 or more damage to a Size 5 or smaller creature with a battleaxe attack, you may choose to Shove the creature 1 Pace away from you instead of dealing damage. At 20th level, the creature is shoved 2 Paces, instead.
When you hit a Size 5 or smaller creature with a glaive attack, you may use a Reactive Action to move the creature 2 Paces to the left or right.

After dealing damage to a creature with a glaive attack, you may use a Reactive Action to reduce the creature's Maximum Hit Points by an amount equal to the damage dealt. This reduction lasts until the creature completes a Furlough.
While holding a glaive, your Jump increases by 1. At 20th level, it increases by 2, instead.

For 3 AP and 1 EP, make a Called Shot (7) using a halberd you are wielding with two hands targeting the head of a creature within 1 Pace. On a success, deal damage as normal. If the damage triggers a Pain Response, the creature dies instantly if it cannot survive without a head.
After you hit a creature with a halberd attack while wielding that halberd with two hands, you may use a Reactive Action to make an additional attack against the target. The attack deals Impale.
Spend 1 EP to increase the Reach of all halberds you wield by 1 Pace until the end of the current turn.
Immediately after reloading a heavy crossbow, you may use a Reactive Action to make an attack with it.
When a creature wearing heavy or bulky armor suffers a Pain Response as a result of damage you dealt with a heavy crossbow, the armor's bonus is reduced by 1 until the armor is repaired.
When using a heavy crossbow to attack a creature wearing heavy or bulky armor, the target's Defense (Armored and Unarmored) is reduced by 1 for the attack.

When you draw your katana, you may use a Reactive Action to make a melee attack using the katana against a creature within its Reach. Each point of damage dealt by this attack above 1 is Sonic Damage.

When you reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points with a katana you are wielding with two hands, you may use a Reactive Action to make another katana attack against a different creature you can see within 2 Paces.
During combat, when you reduce a Size 1 or larger creature to 0 Hit Points with a katana you are wielding with two hands, decapitate it and gain 1 ReP.
After you attack with a longbow, you may use a Reactive Action to attack the same target an additional time with your longbow.
When you attack with a longbow and the attack is Enhanced by the Aim action, the Intended and Extended Ranges of the longbow are doubled.
Spend 1 EP to reduce the AP cost of attacks you make with a longbow by 1 until the end of the current turn. At 20th level, this reduces the cost by 2, instead.

For 1 AP while wielding a longsword with two hands, you may spend 1 EP to attack a creature within the longsword's Reach. The attack deals an additional 2 damage, then 1 direct damage to a creature 1 Pace behind the original target.

After dealing damage to a creature with a longsword, you may use a Reactive Action to make an additional attack against it. The attack is +1 Enhanced for each attack you have made against the target, this turn (regardless of whether they hit). Damage dealt cannot exceed 1 and is always Strike.
Drawing or sheathing any longsword has an action cost of 0.
After using a pike to deal damage to a Size 5 or smaller creature, you may use a Reactive Action to push it 1 Pace away from you. At 20th level, this becomes 2 Paces.
For 2 AP and 1 EP, use a pike to attack a creature within 1 Pace. The attack is +1 Enhanced and deals an additional 2 damage on a hit.
All pikes you wield have the Protean property.
For 1 AP and 1 EP, make a Dexterity Check while wielding a rapier. For each success, gain 1 ReP. Any unspent ReP gained in this manner is lost at the end of the current turn.
When you would deal damage to a creature with a rapier attack, you may choose to force the creature to drop one item it is holding (your choice of which item) instead of dealing damage.
Rapier attacks you make deal an additional 1 damage for each Enhancement on the attack, to a maximum of an additional 3 damage.

For 2 AP, use a recurve bow to attack a creature within the bow's Extended Range. If you deal at least 1 damage, the damage becomes equal to the target's Pain Limit. If you fail to deal 1 or more damage, the bowstring snaps and 4 AP must be used to repair it before it can be used again.
You do not gain Flaws for firing recurve bows within their Extended Range.
Attacks you make against targets who are currently flying are +1 Enhanced.
For 1 AP, choose a creature you can see. Your saber attacks against the creature are +1 Enhanced until the start of your next turn.
After you deal damage to a creature with a saber, you may make an attack against it for 1 AP. This attack is +1 Flawed for each attack you have made with a saber, this turn.
When you are holding a saber and are not Flanked, all creatures of your choice within 1 Pace of you are Flanked.
For 1 AP, grant scythes you wield the Extend property until the start of your next turn.
Attacks you make with scythes are +1 Enhanced.

When you roll 4 or more successes with a scythe attack, you may spend 3 successes to damage additional targets. Spend remaining successes dealing 1 direct damage to targets within the scythe's Reach. You may not deal more than 1 direct damage to a single target when activating this perk.

When you Grapple a Size 5 or smaller creature while holding your whip, you may use your whip to perform the grapple. A creature grappled in this way takes 1 direct damage each time it fails to escape the grapple and you may spend 1 AP to deal an additional 1 direct damage to it on your turn.
When you hit a creature or object with a Size equal to or greater than your own, you may use a Reactive Action to pull yourself 1 Pace toward it.
When you hit a creature or object with a Size equal to or less than your own, you may use a Reactive Action to pull the target 1 Pace toward you.

For 3 AP, swing your colossal sword in an arc targeting 2-3 creatures within the colossal sword's Reach who are each adjacent to each other. The attack requires no Attack Check and deals 1 direct damage to each creature. At 20th level, this becomes 2 direct damage.
After missing with a melee attack using a colossal sword, you may use a Reactive Action to deal 1 direct damage to the target. At 20th level, this becomes 2 direct damage.

After hitting with a melee attack using a colossal sword, you may use a Reactive Action to move to an unoccupied space you choose within 1 Pace of the target without provoking Advantage Attacks. At 20th level, this becomes 2 Paces.
For 1 AP, increase the Reach of great axes you wield by 1 until the start of your next turn.
For 1 AP, expend up to 3 EP. For each EP spent, your next great axe attack before the start of your next turn deals an additional 1 damage.

For 3 AP, while wielding a great axe, choose a creature within 3 Paces and move to the nearest unoccupied space adjacent to the creature, then make a great axe attack against it. The attack is +1 Enhanced for each Pace you moved as part of this action.

For 3 AP, make an Attack Check against a target using a greatbow. If you deal at least 1 damage to the creature, you may spend any remaining successes pushing the target 1 Pace away from you per success spent.
Immediately after attacking with a greatbow, you may use a Reactive Action to attack the same target again. The attack is +1 Enhanced but deals 1 less damage.
When you attack with a greatbow and the attack is Enhanced by the Aim action, the Intended and Extended Ranges of the greatbow are doubled.

When you reduce a creature to 1 or fewer Hit Points with a great club attack, you may use a Reactive Action to destroy its body, instantly killing it preventing its physical body from regenerating. This feature does not work against Ethereals.
After triggering a Pain Response in a creature with a great club attack, you may use a Reactive Action to trigger that Pain Response an additional time.

Once per combat encounter, spend 2 AP and 1 ReP to draw a great club and force all creatures of your choice within 5 Paces to make a Wile Check (3). On a failure, a creature is Terrified of you until the start of your next turn. At 20th level, the difficulty of the Wile Check increases by 1.
After attacking with a great sword, you may use a Reactive Action to make an additional great sword attack. The additional attack must be against a creature you have not yet attacked, this turn.

When you would deal 1 or more damage with a great sword attack, you may turn the attack into a guard break instead of dealing damage as normal. If you do, the attack deals 1 direct Strike and the target becomes Slowed until it ends its turn. At 20th level, the target is Slowed until the end of your next turn, instead.
The Reach of all great swords you wield increases by 1.
After firing the last piece of ammunition in a hand ballista, you may use a Reactive Action to fully reload the hand ballista.
When you deal 1 or more damage to a creature within 2 Paces using a hand ballista, you may use a Reactive Action to turn the attack into a Critical Hit.

When you land a Critical Hit using a hand ballista, the creature must make a Vigor Check (3) or be Shoved 2 Paces away and fall Deposed. A creature who succeeds on the check is shoved 1 Pace away and does not fall Deposed.

When you would deal 2 or more damage to a creature using a maul, you may use a Reactive Action and spend 3 ReP to change the damage dealt to a value equal to your Vigor Attribute, then deal 1 direct damage to a creature you choose within 1 Pace of the initial target.
When a creature wearing heavy or bulky armor suffers a Pain Response as a result of damage you dealt with a maul, the armor's bonus is reduced by 1 until it is repaired.
Once per combat encounter, when you draw a maul, the Attack action costs 1 less AP for you until the end of your turn.

For 4 AP and 2 ReP, instead of attacking a single target with artillery, make a single attack targeting up to 3 creatures you can see, all of whom must be within 5 Paces of one another. Consume ammunition from your chamber as though you had attacked each creature individually.

For 3 ReP, after attacking with artillery, you may designate up to 2 allies you can see. Those allies may move up to their Pace toward the attack's target without provoking Advantage Attacks or spending AP/EP.

Before attacking with artillery, spend 2 ReP. After the initial attack is resolved, creatures within 5 Paces of the attack target (including the target) must either take 1 damage of the ammunition's type or fall Deposed.

When you deal damage to a creature using an auto-pistol, you may make an additional attack against the same target as a Reactive Action. The attack is +1 Flawed for each auto-pistol attack you have made, this turn.

When you score a Critical Hit against a creature with an auto-pistol, you may expend as many bullets as desired from the auto-pistol's chamber in increments of 5. For every 5 additional bullets expended, add 1 to the damage dealt.

Before making an attack with an auto-pistol, you may spend 1 EP to expend as many additional bullets as desired from your chamber. For each bullet expended beyond the first (required) bullet, the attack is +1 Enhanced.

For 2 AP while wielding an auto-rifle, expend as many bullets as desired from your auto-rifle in increments of 5, targeting no creatures or objects. All enemies within 300 Paces who can hear the gunshots must make a Wile Check (3). Checks are +1 Flawed for every 5 bullets you expended. On a failure, a creature is Terrified of you until the end of your next turn.

For 4 AP while wielding an auto-rifle with at least 15 bullets loaded into it, expend 1 EP to empty your auto-rifle's current magazine into a target you can see within the weapon's Intended Range. All bullets are expended from the auto-rifle. The attack deals 1 direct damage to the target for every 5 bullets expended.

For 3 AP while wielding an auto-rifle, expend as many bullets as desired and make an Attack Check against a creature within the auto-rifle's Intended Range. The attack is +1 Enhanced for each additional bullet expended beyond the first (required) bullet, but damage dealt cannot exceed the number of Enhancements rolled.

When you deal 1 or more damage to a creature you can see within 2 Paces of you with a bullet fired from a handgun, you may use a Reactive Action to add your Dexterity Attribute to the damage dealt. If the attack triggers a Pain Response, the target creature must make a Vigor Check against its own Pain Limit or die instantly if it cannot survive without a head.
For 1 AP, attack with a fully-loaded handgun.
When you draw a handgun, you may use a Reactive Action to make an attack with it. The attack is +1 Enhanced.
You can wield two-handed rifles with one hand. Wielding a rifle in this way imposes +1 Flaw on attacks made with the rifle and prevents the rifle from firing beyond its Intended Range.
Attack Checks made with a rifle have their odds of success raised by 10%.
When you attack with a rifle and the attack is Enhanced by the Aim action, the Intended and Extended Ranges of the rifle are doubled.
You may treat your shotgun as a makeshift melee weapon. When wielded in this way, it always deals 2 Strike when damaging a creature.

When you load your shotgun, you can choose to overcharge it. The next attack made with an overcharged shotgun has an additional 4d4 weapon die but cannot hit creatures outside of its Intended Range. If an overcharged shotgun Misfires, the gun explodes, dealing 2 direct Fire to you and (if it is non-magical) destroying the gun.
Creatures within 2 Paces of you damaged by a shell from your shotgun always suffer a Pain Response regardless of the amount of damage taken. At 20th level, the range for this effect becomes 4 Paces.
